app.name: AgriScan 3D
hero.title: Know your fruit's grade before you sell it
hero.subtitle: Photograph a fruit. AgriScan finds defects, reads ripeness, measures size and tells you where it should go: premium, local market, processing or reject.
drop.title: Drop a fruit photo here
drop.hint: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 10 MB. One fruit on a plain light background.
preview.title: Your photo
camera.hint: Hold the fruit steady on a plain light background.
phone.hint: Opens your phone's camera app and brings the photo back here.
options.reference_hint: Place a credit card flat beside the fruit, at the same distance, to get size in millimetres.
samples.title: No photo handy? Try a sample
samples.note: Samples are computer-generated illustrations, not real fruit photos.
result.title: Inspection result
result.experimental_note: No trained defect model is loaded, so defects come from an experimental colour-anomaly check. Treat them as hints.
size.relative_note: No reference card found, so only relative size is shown.
recommendation.premium: Premium packaging and retail or export sale
recommendation.processing: Juice, pulp, jam or food processing
explain.defects_one: One visible defect ({types}) covering about {pct}% of the fruit was detected.
explain.defects_other: {count} visible defects ({types}) covering about {pct}% of the fruit in total were detected.
reason.severe_defect: A severe defect (rot or fungal spot) was found.
reason.large_area: Defects cover more than {limit}% of the fruit.
reason.defect_area_c: Defects cover {pct}% of the fruit (more than {limit}%).
reason.defect_area_b: A small defect area ({pct}%) was found.
reason.unripe: The fruit is not yet ripe.
reason.undersize: The fruit is smaller than the premium minimum size.
reason.clean: No defects, good ripeness, even colour and regular shape.
warning.reference_not_found: A reference width was given, but no card was found in the photo.
warning.multiple_objects: More than one object was found; the largest was used as the fruit.
errors.too_blurry: The photo is too blurry. Hold steady and retake it.
errors.too_dark: The photo is too dark. Add light and retake it.
errors.too_small: The photo resolution is too low. Use a larger photo.
errors.no_fruit: No fruit was found. Use a plain light background with one fruit in the frame.
errors.invalid_file: This file is not a valid JPG, PNG or WEBP image.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than {max} MB.
errors.too_many_pixels: The image is too large to process.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.camera_insecure: The camera needs a secure (HTTPS) connection.
errors.camera_unavailable: No camera was found on this device.
errors.busy: The server is busy. Please try again in a moment.
history.title: Recent analyses
history.subtitle: The last {n} inspections are kept on this server.
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Analyze a fruit and it will be listed.
footer.disclaimer: AI-based quality-assistance suggestion, not certified agricultural or food-safety grading.
report.title: AgriScan 3D inspection report
